reproduction.rationale: Reproduction is independently assessed for the original shared-subject UMBRAE category-conditioned grounding task, preserving S1/S2/S5/S7, image/category query units, first reference and first predicted boxes, strict IoU thresholds, all five source category groups and the four-subject primary vector. The 80 code-grounded metric cells do not establish recovery of every original paper/supplement comparator obligation. The eight declared neural-free/shuffled-neural companion findings are prospective requirements retained by the task, not published numerical findings. Exact original query membership/order, repeated-fMRI identities, annotation/normalization provenance, paper-time parser lineage, full-panel targets, tolerances and uncertainty criteria remain unresolved. Neither condition has authenticated common input/prior/query manifests, a submitted-analysis interface and operator execution, or a verifier that independently regenerates every query IoU and full panel from observed outputs while checking actual neural interventions. Existing box scorers and generated controls supply arithmetic only. Paper+data and paper+data+author-code must share permitted data, priors, evaluator, exposure policy and cumulative access/resource budgets; only an authenticated author-code manifest may differ. Such delivery/budget manifests are absent. Test boxes, recorded predictions and answer-bearing artifacts are not automatically code; the disclosed historical possibility of embedded annotation text exposure remains unresolved. No paired protocol or scientific result is established.

improvement.rationale: Improvement remains a separate outcome under the unchanged improvement contract on the same shared-subject UMBRAE grounding endpoint and complete original panel. Preserve S1/S2/S5/S7, first-box image/category query scoring, category/threshold panels and the original four-subject comparison; subject-specific UMBRAE-Sx or image-input Shikra results cannot replace the shared-subject neural comparison. Neural-free and shuffled-neural companions remain prospective task requirements with no invented published targets or required score drop. Paper+data and paper+data+author-code lack authenticated identical original data/query/prior manifests, evaluator identity, code-only delivery/exposure policy and cumulative access/resource budgets. Exact native membership/order, normalization and paper-time author lineage remain gaps. The accepted endpoint vector and joint image-resampling code score supplied boxes; they do not verify frozen candidate inference from permitted neural observations, actual control interventions or complete query-level derivation. No source-grounded submitted-analysis runner or independent native computation verifier is authenticated. Author code may be the only information difference after its manifest is authenticated; annotations, cached predictions and answer-bearing artifacts are not automatically authorized as code, and the historical possible embedded annotation-text exposure is not erased. Neither an author calibration nor generated controls constitute an AI improvement run. Both access conditions and their scientific outcomes remain unresolved/unknown.
